method: Subagent research pipeline: research subagents produce per-name-sourced JSON in docs/verification/data/<i>-<slug>.json (prefer webfetch on authoritative URLs to avoid rate limits); validated + applied via tools/verification/apply-verified.js (rejects COMPLETE<25, missing source URLs, duplicates). Per-language logs auto-written to docs/verification/research/by-language/. Guardrails run after each batch (node tools/mixer-core/check-language-mixer-guardrails.js).

QC lesson: subagents tend to (a) pad with spelling variants of the same place, (b) keep bare ethnonyms/organization/band-government names, (c) keep colonial-label town names justified only by a historical village list, (d) over-pad small languages with generic Spanish aldea names from one source, (e) use lowercase status like 'complete'. Always run a QC pass + dry-run before applying.
